title: The S&P 500 Has a 5% Problem And It Could Decide What Happens Next
summary: Ed Yardeni said on Monday that the Fed’s Stock Valuation Model may finally be working again and is sending a surprisingly bullish signal for the S&P 500. But there is one catch.The 10-year Treasury yield cannot rise too far above 5%. That threshold could become one of the most important numbers for stocks.
